jobs.title: Database Administrator (DBA)
jobs.description: Requires 6+ years of experience. 6+ years as an MSSQL DBA at expert level: query optimization, execution plans, indexing strategy, locking and concurrency, T-SQL Proven experience with large-scale databases: high volume, high concurrency, multiterabyte scale, and corresponding tuning Hands-on production experience with Amazon Redshift (or comparable MPP warehouse such as Snowflake/BigQuery), with willingness to go deep on Redshift
